title: Key rotation revokes outstanding receipts using caller-mutable RxFrame facade
description: Security review: reset_fragment_sessions_for_rekey selects receipts to invalidate from the caller-visible RxFrame sender_pubkey instead of the detached snapshot. Mutating the facade before rotation can preserve an old-key DIO-time receipt, which later returns authenticated retired-key data. Index/invalidate by immutable internal snapshot signer/session metadata and add mutation-plus-rotation regression for both old/new receipts.
